responsibility: Maintainer-oriented pretty printer that walks GCC trees and renders them back into Modula-2-like source syntax where possible. It contains formatting logic for declarations, types, expressions, statements, exception constructs, and the Modula-2-specific SET and procedure forms, so its role is diagnostic/debug output for gm2 internal trees rather than compilation, code generation, or driver option handling.
same_name_distinction: Implementation unit for the m2 pretty-printer: it contains the tree-walking and formatting code that renders GCC trees as Modula-2-like text, whereas m2pp.h only publishes the small dumping interface.
